notes: Both retrieved primary full texts have titles and authors matching the assigned references. Supplied replication p. 40 contains references in the retrieved 73-page preprint; task-specific direct replication results are on p. 15. The task-only descriptions do not identify outcome, trial count, or statistical contrast, and request d although these direct-replication results report coefficient alpha. target_match remains null because exact intended test cannot be established. Selected the direct-replication ERN reliability target corresponding to the original discussion near p. 1223. No d conversion performed. No p value is reported for the selected alpha estimates; confidence intervals are not p values. Original/repl sample sizes refer to the selected trial cutoffs, not generic recruitment totals. Original exact alpha at seven trials is not numerically printed in the prose; a qualitative high-alpha statement is not treated as a numerical estimate or digitized from Figure 4.
